candidate_order.discovery_rule: If needed, inspect already-known public mirror tree inventory for FR2xyz then FR2rpy; choose the first available sequence in that name order and lexicographic repository/prefix order. Pin exact commit and declare it before fetching indices/GT timestamps. No source selected by pixels or accuracy.

gt_policy: Fullsource noncomment rows must have8tokens. Parse only timestampcolumn,finite and strictlyincreasing; anyfullsource duplicate rejects candidate regardlessselectedwindow. No numericpose parse.
association_policy: Nearest original RGB timestamp; earlier index resolves ties; all36 selecteddepthframes must haveRGBgap<=.02s andevaluationGTbrackets<=.02s. Preserve repeats as explicitobservations.
selection_policy: Stop at first metadataqualified candidate; no pixel/header downloads/decoding or GTposevalues/accuracyscores inspected.
